answer_1.quote: semantic parsing aims to transform a natural language utterance into a logic form, i.e., a formal, machine-interpretable meaning representation (MR)... we evaluate two neural approaches (a seq2seq model and a grammar-based model) that generate logical forms.

answer_2.quote: we compare the resulting performance of different MRs with two metrics: exact-match accuracy (a logical form is regarded as correct if it is syntactically identical to the gold standard), and execution-match accuracy (regarded as correct if a logical form's execution result is identical to that of the gold standard).
